situations.api-gateway-wt-legacy-export: clean, contained in the default branch, and old
situations.api-gateway-wt-oauth-refresh: work that exists only here and is in no commit
situations.api-gateway-wt-on-external-volume: a worktree locked on purpose, usually on removable or shared storage
situations.api-gateway-wt-rate-limits: commits that the default branch does not contain
situations.infra-cdk-baseline: a repository of its own, which a count based cleanup would treat as one more directory
situations.vendor-sdk-wt-patch-2: a valid worktree whose owner is outside the roots the scan was given
situations.web-console-copy-2: a directory that looks like a working tree and that no repository claims
situations.web-console-wt-billing-table: tracked files modified and not committed
situations.web-console-wt-checkout-v2: a worktree moved on disk, which git repairs rather than forgets
situations.web-console-wt-old-typography: only ignored files a build regenerates, which is not a reason to preserve
situations.web-console-wt-search-filters: recent activity, which is in flight work rather than residue
situations.worker-pipeline-wt-local-env: an ignored file a build does not regenerate, for example a local environment file
situations.worker-pipeline-wt-retry-policy: a worktree whose metadata directory is gone
